description: Painted Tree Boutiques in Mansfield, Texas offers a unique shopping experience that combines the charm of boutique shopping with the convenience of a single location. Located at 1551 Highway 287 North in the thriving Mansfield community, this innovative retail concept features multiple independent shop owners under one roof, each curating their own distinctive space filled with home décor, fashion, and gifts. The boutique marketplace model allows local entrepreneurs to showcase their carefully selected merchandise, creating an ever-changing treasure hunt atmosphere where shoppers can discover new favorites around every corner. Open Monday through Saturday from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM and Sundays from 11:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Painted Tree provides an accessible and engaging shopping destination. With a strong 4.5-star rating from over 240 reviews, the center has established itself as a beloved community gathering place where exploration and discovery meet quality and style.
